plan.summary: Provision a private GKE Autopilot stream processing workload in us-central1 with Workload Identity Federation, Artifact Registry, Pub/Sub pull subscription, Firestore Native database, and a Python asyncio streaming worker performing 1-minute tumbling window aggregations.
plan.architecture_overview: The workload runs on a private GKE Autopilot cluster in us-central1 (complying with VM External IP prohibition via private nodes and Cloud NAT outbound egress). Workload Identity Federation binds Kubernetes Service Account 'sa-stream-worker' in namespace 'stream-apps' to a dedicated GCP IAM Service Account granted roles/pubsub.subscriber and roles/datastore.user without static keys. A Python asyncio worker packaged with Cloud Native Buildpacks pulls batches of up to 50 messages concurrently from Pub/Sub subscription 'stream-gke-sub', aggregates throughput and message latency over 1-minute tumbling windows, persists metrics to the 'stream_metrics' collection in Firestore, exposes HTTP liveness/readiness probes, and scales via HorizontalPodAutoscaler (1 to 2 replicas at 80% CPU utilization).

infra_tasks.title: Enable GCP APIs, VPC Network, Cloud NAT, Pub/Sub, Firestore, and Artifact Registry
infra_tasks.description: Enable container.googleapis.com, pubsub.googleapis.com, firestore.googleapis.com, artifactregistry.googleapis.com, compute.googleapis.com, cloudbuild.googleapis.com, and iam.googleapis.com. Provision private VPC subnet with Private Google Access and Cloud Router/NAT in us-central1 (required so private GKE Autopilot nodes comply with organizational policy prohibiting VM external IPs). Provision Artifact Registry Docker repository, Firestore Native database, Pub/Sub topic, and pull subscription 'stream-gke-sub'.
acceptance_criteria: All required APIs enabled with disable_on_destroy = false
Private VPC subnet and Cloud NAT configured in us-central1 with zero external VM IPs
Pub/Sub topic and pull subscription stream-gke-sub declared
Firestore Native database and Artifact Registry Docker repository declared

infra_tasks.title: Provision Private GKE Autopilot Cluster and Workload Identity IAM Bindings
infra_tasks.description: Provision GKE Autopilot cluster in us-central1 with private_cluster_config (enable_private_nodes = true) to satisfy no-external-IP org policy. Create dedicated GCP Service Account with roles/pubsub.subscriber and roles/datastore.user, and bind roles/iam.workloadIdentityUser for principal serviceAccount:<PROJECT_ID>.svc.id.goog[stream-apps/sa-stream-worker].
acceptance_criteria: Private GKE Autopilot cluster configured in us-central1 with Workload Identity enabled
GCP IAM Service Account granted roles/pubsub.subscriber and roles/datastore.user
Workload Identity binding maps stream-apps/sa-stream-worker with zero static keys

infra_tasks.title: Author Kubernetes Manifests and GitHub Actions CI/CD Pipeline
infra_tasks.description: Create Kubernetes manifests for namespace 'stream-apps', ServiceAccount 'sa-stream-worker' annotated with iam.gke.io/gcp-service-account, Deployment (1 replica, cpu: 250m, memory: 512Mi, HTTP liveness/readiness probes on /healthz and /readyz, env vars for PUBSUB_SUBSCRIPTION_ID and FIRESTORE_DATABASE), and HorizontalPodAutoscaler (minReplicas: 1, maxReplicas: 2, targetCPUUtilizationPercentage: 80). Configure GitHub Actions workflow using WIF to build via Cloud Native Buildpacks (pack/gcloud builds submit --pack), push to Artifact Registry, and apply manifests to GKE.
acceptance_criteria: Namespace stream-apps and annotated ServiceAccount sa-stream-worker defined
Deployment sets 1 replica, 250m CPU, 512Mi memory, and HTTP liveness/readiness probes
HorizontalPodAutoscaler configured for 1-2 replicas at 80% average CPU utilization
GitHub Actions workflow builds via Buildpacks and deploys to GKE with path filtering on apps/ex04-live/** and k8s/**

code_tasks.title: Implement Asyncio Pub/Sub Tumbling Window Stream Worker and Health Server
code_tasks.description: Implement a Python asyncio streaming worker under apps/ex04-live/ packaged via Cloud Native Buildpacks. Subscribe to Pub/Sub pull subscription 'stream-gke-sub' (configurable via env), pull and process streaming batches of up to 50 events concurrently using asyncio semaphore/tasks, compute throughput (events/min, events/sec) and message latency aggregates (min, max, avg, count) over 1-minute tumbling windows, and write time-series metric documents to Firestore collection 'stream_metrics'. Run an embedded async HTTP server (FastAPI/uvicorn or aiohttp) serving /healthz and /readyz probes.
acceptance_criteria: Worker concurrently processes batches up to 50 Pub/Sub messages via asyncio
1-minute tumbling window computes throughput and latency metrics accurately
Window metrics are persisted to Firestore collection stream_metrics and messages acknowledged
HTTP /healthz and /readyz endpoints respond 200 OK and Procfile configures Buildpacks entrypoint

code_tasks.title: Implement Unit Tests for Tumbling Window Aggregator, Worker Batching, and Health Probes
code_tasks.description: Create pytest asyncio unit tests verifying 1-minute tumbling window aggregation math (throughput and latency statistics), concurrent batch processing up to 50 messages with mocked Pub/Sub subscriber and Firestore AsyncClient, HTTP liveness/readiness endpoints, and K8s manifest validation. Document architecture and deployment instructions in README.md.
acceptance_criteria: All pytest unit tests pass using mocked GCP Pub/Sub and Firestore clients
Tests cover 50-event batch concurrency, 1-minute tumbling window flush to stream_metrics, and health endpoints
README.md documents GKE Autopilot Workload Identity and stream worker design

plan.risk_assessment: GKE Autopilot cluster management fee (~$73/mo) exceeds Tier 2 autonomous cost ceiling ($40/mo), classifying this build as Tier 3 requiring human approval. GKE Autopilot provisions underlying Compute Engine node VMs, so private_cluster_config (enable_private_nodes = true) with Cloud NAT in us-central1 [HEALTHY] is enforced to strictly satisfy the organizational policy prohibiting VM external IPs.
